This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on September 3 across legendary European wartime news reporting (Edward R. Murrow broadcasting live from London on the 1939 outbreak of war and the 1940 Battle of Britain daylight Blitz), debonair private investigator mysteries, national talent competitions, classic Dickens literary dramatizations, and 1960s sci-fi radio theatre, Edward R.
